subject: Acme MAP final sign-off / go-live & signature readiness
messages: From: Marissa Cole To: Samantha Cole , Tom Li Cc: Ben Carter , Camila Reyes Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700 Subject: Acme MAP draft + next steps (post-demo recap) Hi Samantha / Tom — Great to meet you both on the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on timeline and responsibilities: Key success criteria (from today): - Latency: 95th percentile under 250ms for the chat endpoint with our 8k context load. - Cost: Target unit cost reduction of 30% vs current baseline through batching + quantization. - Security: VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS; SOC2 evidence review completed. Attached is the MAP draft (ACME_MAP_v3.pdf) with milestones and owners. High-level milestones: 1) Pilot kickoff (redwood hosted) — target: 2026-08-17 — Owner: Acme (Samantha) / Redwood (Marissa) 2) Integration & validation — target: 2026-08-31 — Owner: Acme Eng / Redwood DevRel 3) Canary & perf tuning — target: 2026-09-14 — Owner: Redwood Infra / Acme Eng 4) Go-live / handoff — target: 2026-09-21 — Owner: Acme PM / Redwood Customer Success Open dependencies called out in the MAP: Acme procurement signature, environment access (VPC peering), and SOC2 evidence delivery. Can you review the attached and confirm (a) the milestones look right, (b) owners are correct, and (c) target close / signature date feasibility? If it looks good I can send this to your legal/procurement as the working MAP and escalate the SOW draft. Next steps I propose: - You confirm owners and dates by EOD Wed 2026-08-05 - Redwood to provision pilot cluster on 2026-08-12 (internal) - Procurement review / redlines by 2026-08-10 Thanks — enjoyed the conversation. Best, Marissa Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123 Attachments: ACME_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP draft), SOW_ACME_2026.docx (SOW draft) From: Samantha Cole To: Marissa Cole , Ben Carter Cc: Camila Reyes , Tom Li Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700 Subject: Re: Acme MAP draft + next steps (post-demo recap) Thanks Marissa — this is clear and very helpful. I reviewed the MAP with our PM and Eng leads. Quick notes: - Milestones and owners look correct overall. Please change Pilot kickoff target to 2026-08-19 (we have a company holiday on the 17th). - Procurement will aim to return redlines by 2026-08-12 instead of the 10th — slightly tighter on their side. Tom is looped in for procurement. - We need clarification on the data retention default in the MAP (what's the default retention for embeddings?). Tom — can you confirm procurement timeline? Also copying our Legal alias for any clause-level questions. Samantha Head of AI Products | Acme Corp samantha.cole@acme.com -----Original Message----- On Mon, 3 Aug 2026 at 14:05, Marissa Cole wrote: > Great to meet you both on the demo today... From: Tom Li To: Samantha Cole , Marissa Cole Cc: Ben Carter , Camila Reyes , Legal Team Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700 Subject: Re: Acme MAP draft + next steps (post-demo recap) Marissa / Samantha — Procurement can turn around initial redlines by EOD 2026-08-12 as requested by Samantha. We'll flag any material commercial changes — expect mostly standard language and a few payment-term items. On data retention: our legal requests guidance on embedding retention defaults. Marissa — can you confirm Redwood's default retention policy for embeddings in Hosted vs Private deployments and whether we can configure retention per workspace? If you can include a short blurb in the MAP it will help speed legal sign-off. Tom Sr. Procurement Manager | Acme Corp Tom.Li@acme.com > On Wed, Aug 5, 2026 at 09:12 AM Samantha Cole wrote: > > Thanks Marissa — this is clear... From: Marissa Cole To: Samantha Cole , Tom Li Cc: Ben Carter , Camila Reyes , Legal Team Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -0700 Subject: Re: Acme MAP draft + next steps (post-demo recap) Tom / Samantha — Thanks — noted on dates. I've updated the MAP (v3) to reflect: Pilot kickoff 2026-08-19; procurement redlines target 2026-08-12. I added a short section on data retention: - Hosted API (default): transient embeddings retained for 30 days by default; longer retention configurable with enterprise controls and opt-in; customer-managed KMS available on Dedicated/Private. - Private (VPC/on-prem): retention policy controlled by customer; Redwood does not retain data beyond customer-configured retention. I've attached the updated MAP and the SOW draft. Next steps I recommend: - Tom/legal to return redlines by 2026-08-12 - Redwood to provision pilot staging cluster on 2026-08-13 (we'll confirm capacity internally) - Target signature / go-live: 2026-09-20 (we had discussed a September three-week window; this gives one week for canary tuning) If procurement returns only minor redlines we can spin DocuSign and aim for the target signature week. Ben (cc) will own the SOW/PT details and the DocuSign flow. Best, Marissa Attachments: ACME_MAP_v3.pdf, SOW_ACME_2026.docx From: Ben Carter To: Samantha Cole , Tom Li , Marissa Cole Cc: Camila Reyes , Legal Team Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700 Subject: RE: Acme MAP final sign-off / go-live & signature readiness Folks — quick update from our side: procurement redlines received this morning (thanks Tom). Legal reviewed and flagged two non-material changes to payment terms and an audit rights clause; we accepted both and integrated changes into the SOW. I've uploaded the final SOW to DocuSign and started the envelope for Acme legal. Link below. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/placeholder-signature-link Current status: - MAP: finalized and agreed on milestones (ACME_MAP_v3.pdf) - SOW: final version uploaded, awaiting Acme signature - Pilot provisioning: scheduled for 2026-08-13 (Redwood infra) - Target go-live: 2026-09-20 (tentative, contingent on pilot validation) Samantha / Tom — please confirm who will be the primary signer on the Acme side and whether your legal needs any additional supporting artifacts (SOC2 package, KMS attestation). If everything looks good we'll mark the MAP as signed and move to the DocuSign signature stage. Thanks — Ben Carter Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference ben.carter@redwood.ai > On Fri, Aug 7, 2026 at 04:30 PM Marissa Cole wrote: > > Tom / Samantha —
